description: Source code for Slack message sending module, including functions for posting messages, handling media uploads, caching, and error handling within a Slack integration.

methods.name: hasCustomIdentity
methods.description: Checks if a SlackSendIdentity object has custom icon or username fields set.

methods.name: isSlackCustomizeScopeError
methods.description: Determines if an error is related to missing 'chat:write.customize' scope in Slack API.

methods.name: postSlackMessageBestEffort
methods.description: Attempts to send a Slack message with optional identity customization, retries without custom identity if scope error occurs.

methods.name: resolveToken
methods.description: Resolves the Slack bot token from explicit input, fallback, or environment configuration.

methods.name: parseRecipient
methods.description: Parses a raw string into a SlackRecipient object with kind and id.

methods.name: createSlackDmCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key for Slack DM channels based on account, token, and recipient ID.

methods.name: setSlackDmChannelCache
methods.description: Manages the Slack DM channel cache, maintaining a maximum size.

methods.name: resolveChannelId
methods.description: Resolves the Slack channel ID, opening a DM if necessary, with caching.

methods.name: clearSlackDmChannelCache
methods.description: Clears the Slack DM channel cache.

methods.name: uploadSlackFile
methods.description: Uploads a file to Slack, handling media fetching, presigned URL upload, and completion.

methods.name: sendMessageSlack
methods.description: Main function to send a message to Slack, handling text, blocks, media, chunking, and caching.
